title: The floating tool bar is as short as the mock draws it
goal: The glass tool bar under the canvas is now as tight side to side as the video mock, but it is still 48 points tall where the mock draws 38, so it covers more of the picture than the user drew. Its zoom slider also runs longer than the mock's. Bring both to the mock on Next.
notes: Found while tightening the bar (task the-floating-tool-bar-sits-as-tight-as-the-mock, 2026-09-28). Side by side: queue/audits/2026-09-28-tight-tool-bar-side-by-side.png. Mock: docs/design/mocks/shared/components/toolbar.css .cnv .tbar padding var(--s1) var(--s2) round 28pt .tool, so 38pt with the 1px border; .zslider width 92px. App: EditorChromeLayout.toolBarGroupHeight = 48 is shared by Current's capsules and feeds toolBarCovers / aboveToolBar / the tool settings stack, so the one bar needs its own height (ToolBarSpacing is where the one bar's numbers now live) and those derived bands must read the bar in use. ToolBarSpacing.oneGlass.endPadding is 10 = the rim at 48pt; at 38pt the rim is 5 and the mock's end is 8 + 1. Zoom slider width lives in EditorView.zoomBar (110).
acceptance: At Next defaults the one glass bar is 38pt tall, as video.html's .tbar is (28pt row, 4pt rim, 1pt edge), and the tools stay 28pt
A fitted picture still clears the bar, and the tool settings capsule still stacks above it without overlapping
The zoom slider on the one bar is the mock's 92pt
Current's separate capsules keep their 48pt height
one-glass-tool-bar-walk and a-fitted-picture-clears-the-tool-bar-walk pass at Next defaults

log.note: Adversarial pass before building: a 38pt bar leaves a 5pt rim round the 28pt tools, the same as the mock's 4pt padding + 1pt edge. What could break: every band that clears the bar (fit, notice pill, crop/trim capsules, tool settings capsule, measure legend) read the one 48pt constant, so each had to read the bar in use or it would float 10pt too high or the fit would leave a dead band. The grid-adjust bar replaces the one bar, so it takes the same height or everything above it would jump. A Premiere/FCP user sees a slimmer floating bar; nothing about hit targets changes (tools stay 28pt).

Built: EditorChromeLayout.ToolBarSpacing gained height (capsules 48, oneGlass 38) and zoomSliderWidth (110 / 92); oneGlass endPadding 10 -> 9 (mock's 8pt + 1pt edge). toolBarCovers(bar:), aboveToolBar(toolSettingsHeight:bar:), toolSettingsFrame/toolBarFrame/bottomNoticeFrame/bottomChrome take bar: (default .capsules). App reads Experiments.shared.toolBar for the fit, measure legend, overlays, group heights, grid-adjust bar and slider. Walk toolBar step can claim height and zoomSlider (probe-only ZoomSliderProbe).

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 10436 tests green. one-glass-tool-bar-walk ok (glass 38pt, slider 92pt at every stage, 4 real captures); a-fitted-picture-clears-the-tool-bar-walk ok (computed bar top 846 = measured glass top 846, picture ends 24pt above). Also ok: tool-settings-capsule, tool-settings-narrow, tool-settings-twice, toolbar-row-lines-up, toolbar-row-narrow, a-notice-lets-a-click-through, grid-guides, video-tool-bar, trim-is-a-tool, zoom-readout-double-click. Side by side at 2x: mock bar ~75px/slider ~185px, app ~74px/184px.

Rough items: the non-concentric end, the tight grid-adjust buttons, and the circle-vs-rounded-square tools and chevron readout are known, visible only on close comparison, and left in the audit for the user to react to rather than filed. left rough: toolBar step's 'they DO NOT line up' line counts groups from an earlier window still open in the walk (Color at another centre); cosmetic in the log only, the claims read the newest bar.
